results.title: The federation against each site alone
results.description: Held-out evaluation, 28 September 2026. Every cohort was fine-mapped on the same 8,100 fresh simulation instances over 54 loci, by the same inference driver; intervals are 95% locus bootstraps. The smart composition is the best 50,000-person cohort the composition search found. The search selected Covenant's own cohort, so its rows equal Covenant's.

artifacts.title: Fine-mapping performance on held-out loci
artifacts.description: Power, resolution, high-confidence yield and paired power differences for the full 150,000-person federation, each 50,000-person site alone, and the smart composition.

artifacts.title: Held-out metrics by cohort
artifacts.description: Each estimate with its 95% interval. Power: the share of instances whose credible sets capture a causal variant. Yield: the share whose causal variant reaches PIP > 0.95. Coverage: the share of credible sets that hold a causal variant. False discoveries: the share of variants at PIP > 0.95 that are not causal. Causal set size: the mean number of variants in the smallest credible set holding a causal variant.

artifacts.title: Power gained by federating
artifacts.description: Full federation minus each cohort on identical instances, in percentage points (pp), with 95% paired intervals.

artifacts.title: Composition search: 20 candidate cohorts
artifacts.description: Fixed 50,000-person site and ancestry allocations, ranked by power on separate development draws; the metrics are defined as in the held-out table. All 20 passed the calibration screen (coverage at least 93%, false discoveries at most 5%). The winner was frozen before the held-out draws were simulated.

results.title: Parity: federated equals pooled
results.description: Benchmark run, 14 September 2026. 11,850 instances over 79 loci, fine-mapped once from the sites' summed second moments and once on the pooled data. Every result is identical.

artifacts.title: Federated against centralized, statistic by statistic
artifacts.description: PIP of the causal variant, the locus's maximum PIP, credible-set size and the number of credible sets returned. The lower row is the difference: zero for every instance.

artifacts.title: One locus, six ancestries, one posterior
artifacts.description: Per-ancestry association tracks and the joint SuSiEx posterior at locus L0000, with one causal variant at the weakest heritability (h² = 0.0005). The joint fit places PIP 1.00 on the simulated causal variant.

artifacts.title: Parity record
artifacts.description: The run's parity gate, comparing every PIP, credible-set member and fit status.

results.title: Accuracy across the simulation design
results.description: The benchmark's 11,820 shared-causal instances, fine-mapped across the full federation: 150,000 individuals in six ancestry columns. The figure forms follow the SuSiEx paper (Yuan et al., Nature Genetics 2024). The run's 30 ancestry-divergent instances were withdrawn and are not shown.

artifacts.title: Recall along the two design arms
artifacts.description: Power against per-locus heritability and against cross-ancestry genetic correlation, by the number of causal variants.

artifacts.title: Where fine-mapping puts its confidence
artifacts.description: PIP of the true causal variant, credible-set size and purity, by heritability.

artifacts.title: Confidently fine-mapped variants
artifacts.description: Causal variants identified at PIP above 0.5 and 0.95, as counts and as a rate.

artifacts.title: Yield against calibration, per design cell
artifacts.description: Each point is one design cell and LD-divergence stratum. Coverage stays near the nominal 95% across the range of yield.

artifacts.title: Fine-mapping against cross-site LD divergence
artifacts.description: Power, high-confidence yield, calibration and resolution by LD-divergence stratum and genetic correlation.

artifacts.title: LD divergence or LD strength?
artifacts.description: The divergence score tracks LD strength (r = +0.945 over 79 loci), so the falling resolution in panels a–c is an LD-strength effect, not an LD-diversity result.

artifacts.title: Per-population causal probability
artifacts.description: SuSiEx's population-specific causal probability, by ancestry column. The share called causal follows each column's sample size.

artifacts.title: Fit outcomes
artifacts.description: Every fit converged without error. Empty results, where no credible set is returned, concentrate at the lowest heritability.

artifacts.title: Effect sizes across ancestries
artifacts.description: Per-allele effect estimates of fine-mapped variants, EUR against each other ancestry. The scatter widens as the ancestry column shrinks.

artifacts.title: Full-federation power by architecture
artifacts.description: The share of instances whose credible sets capture a causal variant, for each of the 15 architectures.

artifacts.title: Calibration at the weakest signal
artifacts.description: The share of 95% credible sets holding a causal variant at h² = 0.0005, for the full federation and for each site fine-mapped alone.

results.title: Exploratory data analysis
results.description: The simulated package before any fine-mapping: 150,000 synthetic HAPNEST genomes split into three disjoint 50,000-person site cohorts, and the phenotypes simulated on them.

artifacts.title: Site cohorts by ancestry
artifacts.description: Three sites, each dominated by a different ancestry. Every individual appears at exactly one site.

artifacts.title: Ancestry columns, alone and together
artifacts.description: A column needs at least 1,000 individuals to enter the fit. Pooled, the federation has all six; no site alone has more than five.

artifacts.title: Simulation design
artifacts.description: Fifteen architectures in two arms, heritability and genetic correlation, sharing their centre cell. Each cell holds 790 instances.

artifacts.title: Linkage disequilibrium seen from three sites
artifacts.description: The same window at a high- and a low-divergence locus, with the difference between two sites.

artifacts.title: Causal-variant allele frequencies
artifacts.description: Frequency spectra of the causal variants at each site, and the share below each frequency floor.

artifacts.title: Realised against target heritability
artifacts.description: Per-locus heritability achieved at each site against the target.

artifacts.title: Recovered cross-ancestry effect correlation
artifacts.description: The correlation of the drawn causal effects across ancestries against the target genetic correlation.

artifacts.title: Allele coding against the reference
artifacts.description: From the evaluation package: all three sites code all 533,532 shared variants against the reference allele, so no variant needs recoding.

results.title: What federating costs
results.description: What each site sends for one locus, and where the compute goes.

artifacts.title: Uplink per locus
artifacts.description: Each site sends one X′X block per ancestry it holds, once: about 0.5 GiB per locus across the federation, in a single round.

artifacts.title: Compute per instance
artifacts.description: Wall-clock per instance on each path. The federated figure is the coordinator's share only; each site's X′X is computed on its own hardware.

artifacts.title: Runtime and what drives it
artifacts.description: Runtime grows with the square of the locus window, not with the number of causal variants.
